newsitem.title: USA: Occidental to increase specialty chemicals.
newsitem.headline: Occidental to increase specialty chemicals.

text.p: Occidental Petroleum Corp plans to strengthen its traditional chemical operations by building a "signficant" specialty chemical business, said Ray Irani, chief executive officer.

Irani, who addressed shareholders at the company's annual meeting Friday, targeted earnings from specialty chemicals at $250 million annually by the year 2000, with growth coming from acquistions and from adding new products at existing facilities.
Excluding specialty items, OxyChem earned $578 million in 1996, down from 1.04 billion the previous year as a result of falling margins for petrochemicals.
Occidental will strenghthen its overall chemical division, OxyChem, through low-cost, incremental expansion, with a focus in vinyls, Irani said.
"(Vinyls) are the keystone to Oxychem's commodity chemical strategy," added Occidental President Dale Laurance.
